correctness.rationale: Twenty three-up-rounding outcomes contain exactly seven strict-order inversion-free patterns. Exact marginal equations yield off-diagonal 3-by-3 transport with rows \(\ell_i\), columns \(1-h_i\), and the remaining all-singletons probability \(1-S\). A three-row Hall cut proof gives exactly four inequalities, valid over real residues. The off-diagonal six-cycle produces a support at most six. A rational quota witness with one-parameter flow interval \([-2,1]\) forces five positive transport arcs and positive singleton mass, so six is sharp. The standalone verifier independently checks 18,169 rational grid profiles and the support witness; finite checks are not offered as general proof.

value.rationale: The six-party, three-distinct-floor-pair, three-surplus-seat setting is the first natural case with three coupled binary prefix blocks and a nontrivial six-cycle coupling. The full feasible chamber has four explicit capacity inequalities; symmetric quotas exhibit the exact boundary \(p=2/3\); the rational witness shows an inherent minimum of six seat-allocation outcomes. These form a motivated exact implementation/feasibility classification rather than an arbitrary numerical slice; no broad algorithmic supremacy or larger-case theorem is claimed.
